name: holo-polymarket
description: Query Polymarket prediction markets and trade via the official CLOB API.

interface.shortDescription: Query and trade Polymarket prediction markets.
interface.longDescription: Skills for Polymarket prediction-market research (hot markets, keyword search, event detail and tokens, historical price/probability and volume trends, whale leaderboard, address positions and trades) and trading through the official CLOB API (dry-run-by-default buy/sell, collateral balance, open orders, and cancellation).
defaultPrompt: Show the hottest Polymarket markets right now.
What are the current odds for this event on Polymarket?
Preview a Polymarket buy order for this market.
